text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner and into the homestretch!!
All the Umamusume begin their final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Guh—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(It's like a frozen hell...!
This chill running through my whole body
must be Kris S's true power...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (However—!!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!
(SKREEEEEECH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet makes her move!!!
Here comes Tanino Gimlet!!!
She surges to the front—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! Tanino Gimlet
superbly claims the Tenno Sho Shield in hand!!!
She has intoxicated all of Nakayama—!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Gimlet is unbelievable!! Kris S was incredible too... What is with this generation?!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aren't those two basically the center of this whole era now?!
That's seriously how good that race was!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing... Gimlet-senpai is so amazing...
...Buuut...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why...
Even though Gimlet-senpai won...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "—Haaaaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why am I... scared out of my mind like this
of Kris S-senpai...
when I wasn't even the one running against him...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's so cold, I'm getting goosebumps...
I've never felt like this before...â

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: (There's no doubt about it... That was the feeling of breaking through my limits and severing the chains of fate...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'd expect nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
However...—I will become—even stronger.
It doesn't end—like this.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that is my intention as well.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "No matter how endlessly strong you become—I will transcend you without fail."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is—still merely the prologue to our glorious history of battle!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...In the next race.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... on to the "next."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Today, I've finally figured it out, Kris S. The true nature of your power...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, you are—the center of the era.
You are on the verge of becoming destiny itself...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haha... Hahahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaaa-hahahahaaaaa---!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, O world. O natural order.
If that is the path you choose—
I shall incinerate it head-on!!"
—A few days after the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —I-Is what they just announced really true...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Can you truly not believe it that much?
Then, I shall tell you once more—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I hereby declare that next year,
I shall run in both the Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen!!
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
D-Did Trainer <username>
decide on that rotation!?
choice_data_list: She and I decided on it together.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Was the possibility of getting injured again
even considered?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Without hardship, there is no challenge.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes fixed upon the path we shall tread.
We shall deliver even greater "swiftness" and "might" to all observers.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "Huh!? Running Yasuda and Takarazuka back-to-back, for real!? She's gonna get injured again doing that!!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"‘No, Trainer, stop this.
No matter how much Gimlet wants to do it,
isn't this being a bit too irresponsible?’"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "I mean, if you ask whether I wanna see it or not, I do, but isn't that a bit too extreme?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"‘It kinda feels like they're hiding behind their
Umamusume's feelings, which leaves a bad taste.
I wish they'd explain a bit more~’"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Our senpais are taking a ton of flak.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't she scared at all?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-senpai gives off such insane pressure,
and there's seriously no telling how deep her strength goes...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Even though you might get injured again running both the Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides... having everyone say
whatever they want about me like this...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm... terrified...
Senpai—!"
Until next year's Yasuda Kinen, time was slowly, yet significantly, beginning to move—
